offline.label: workspace-8
offline.command:
REPORT="$RUNNER_TEMP/vitest-report.json"
rm -f "$REPORT"
set +e
# The bin shim execs node, so a segfault surfaces as 139. Through
# `pnpm exec` a signalled child is reported as exit 1 instead.
./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json="$REPORT" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/vitest-output.log"
EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
if [ "$EXIT" -eq 139 ]; then
  # Count error lines explicitly: a scanner failure leaves ERRORS empty
  # and fails closed instead of reading as "no errors".
  ERRORS="$(sed -E 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$RUNNER_TEMP/vitest-output.log" | grep -cE '^ *Errors +[0-9]+ errors?|Unhandled Errors|error during close' || true)"
  if [ -s "$REPORT" ] && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/vitest-output.log" ] && [ "$ERRORS" = "0" ] \
    && node -e 'const r=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); process.exit(r.success===true && r.numTotalTestSuites>0 && r.numFailedTestSuites===0 && r.numFailedTests===0 ? 0 : 1)' "$REPORT"; then
    echo "::warning::vitest exited with SIGSEGV (139) after it reported a passing run with no unhandled errors — tolerated as a shutdown crash"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "::error::vitest exited with SIGSEGV (139) without a passing report (report present: $([ -s "$REPORT" ] && echo yes || echo no); error lines: ${ERRORS:-unreadable}); the suite did not finish, or it reported failures or unhandled errors"
fi
exit "$EXIT"

# Every shim must be valid bash and exit 0 even when no CLI is
# reachable (the #1921 contract). Probe with an empty PATH (invoke

  echo "checking $sh"
  bash -n "$sh"
  PATH= "$BASH" "$sh" modify-bash </dev/null || { echo "::error::$sh did not exit 0 with no CLI on PATH"; exit 1; }
done

offline.label: statusline-generator-delegation-smoke-2
offline.command:
# #2679: generator now READS .claude/helpers/statusline.cjs as its
# single source of truth rather than duplicating the content in an
# inline template. The delegation contract lives in the HELPER
# file now — grep that instead. Also verify the generator still
# reads it (i.e. the read-and-substitute pattern is intact) so a
# future refactor can't silently break the delegation contract
# by dropping the file read.
HELPER=v3/@claude-flow/cli/.claude/helpers/statusline.cjs
GEN=v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/init/statusline-generator.ts

echo "Checking that the helper delegates to 'hooks statusline --json'..."
grep -q "hooks statusline --json" "$HELPER" \
  || { echo "::error::$HELPER no longer delegates to 'hooks statusline --json' — regression of #2195"; exit 1; }
echo "ok: delegation pattern found in helper"

echo "Checking that the generator reads the helper (#2679 sync pattern)..."
grep -q "statusline.cjs" "$GEN" \
  || { echo "::error::$GEN no longer references statusline.cjs — regression of #2679 read-and-substitute pattern"; exit 1; }
grep -qE "readFileSync.*helperContent|helperContent.*readFileSync" "$GEN" \
  || { echo "::error::$GEN no longer reads helper via readFileSync — regression of #2679"; exit 1; }
echo "ok: read-and-substitute pattern intact"

echo "Checking that the old fragile heuristics are NOT present (in helper)..."
# The buggy fallback computed domains from file-based pattern counts —
# this produced domainsCompleted=0 when AgentDB had 26k+ patterns.
! grep -q "getLearningStats\b" "$HELPER" \
  || { echo "::error::$HELPER still has getLearningStats (old local reader) — regression of #2195"; exit 1; }
! grep -q "getV3Progress\b" "$HELPER" \
  || { echo "::error::$HELPER still has getV3Progress (old local reader) — regression of #2195"; exit 1; }
echo "ok: old local-reader heuristics removed"

echo "Checking that both ADR directories are counted..."
grep -q "v3/docs/adr" "$HELPER" \
  || { echo "::error::$HELPER missing v3/docs/adr ADR directory — regression of #2195 ADR-count bug"; exit 1; }
grep -q "v3/implementation/adrs" "$HELPER" \
  || { echo "::error::$HELPER missing v3/implementation/adrs ADR directory"; exit 1; }
echo "ok: both ADR directories present"

offline.label: wizard-init-regression-guard-6
offline.command:
echo "=== Guard 3: bare .claude/settings.json must NOT trigger duplicate detection ==="

TMP=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$TMP"

# Simulate Claude Code's own project settings.json with NO ruflo registration
mkdir -p .claude
echo '{"env": {}, "hooks": {}}' > .claude/settings.json

# Run init WITHOUT --force; use a custom HOME with no ~/.claude.json
# so the real user's global config doesn't interfere
FAKE_HOME=$(mktemp -d)
OUT=$(HOME="$FAKE_HOME" node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/v3/@claude-flow/cli/bin/cli.js" \
  init 2>&1 || true)

echo "--- init output ---"
echo "$OUT"

# The init must NOT claim "already initialized" due to the bare settings.json
if echo "$OUT" | grep -qi "existing 'ruflo' MCP registration\|existing 'claude-flow' MCP registration"; then
  echo "::error::init false-positives on bare .claude/settings.json (#2207)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "ok: no false-positive on bare .claude/settings.json"

rm -rf "$FAKE_HOME"
echo "Guard 3 passed."
